# Briefing: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA), Meeting of 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026 | **Window reviewed:** 16 October to 15 November 2026 | **Meeting context:** Q3 fiscal 2027 results and earnings call, 17 November 2026

## Executive Summary

NVIDIA is in a leadership transition. Founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO, and board member with immediate effect, ending a 33-year tenure ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while keeping her CFO role ([Mashable, 2026](https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)). The board has also named its first-ever chair, Harvey C. Jones ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). The company reports Q3 results on 17 November, as previously scheduled ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)).

Over the window, the stock fell sharply, and the CEO departure came in the middle of a broader AI-sector sell-off and a congressional and Justice Department scrutiny.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Leadership and Governance

| Date | Development | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 8 Nov 2026 | Board issued statements titled "A Message to Our Company" and "Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors" (titles only; body text not available) | [NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-and-supply-chain-partners-expand-capacity-to-accelerate-ai-infrastructure-buildout) |
| 10 Nov 2026 | Statement from independent board members (title only; body text not available) | [NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-partners-with-apollo-blackrock-blackstone-brookfield-goldman-sachs-and-kkr-to-establish-ai-compute-infrastructure-financing-platforms-to-mobilize-over-500-billion-of-third-party-capital) |
| 11 Nov 2026 | Board accepted Huang's resignation, a day before the announcement ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)) | Data Centre Magazine |
| 12 Nov 2026 | Kress named interim CEO; search for permanent CEO opened, with internal and external candidates considered ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)) | Al Jazeera |
| 12 Nov 2026 | Harvey C. Jones, a director since 1993 and former CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys, named first board chair ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)) | Data Centre Magazine |

**Reason for departure (conflicting and unverified).** NVIDIA gave no reason for the departure ([Mashable, 2026](https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)). Press reports attribute it to affair allegations. One report describes an affair with a fellow executive and a separate relationship with a woman U.S. intelligence officials believe is a Chinese spy ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-ceo-huang-resigns-amid-affair-scandals-board-names-cfo-colette-kress-interim-ceo-135801377.html)). Al Jazeera describes "allegations" of extramarital affairs ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)). On the espionage question, the Attorney General said the Justice Department had not yet determined whether the woman is a Chinese spy ([CNN, 2026](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)). None of these claims should be treated as established fact.

### Executive Hires and Succession

No new executive hires beyond the interim CEO and board chair appear in the provided materials. Commentators have floated permanent-CEO candidates, including Ian Buck, VP of hyperscale and HPC, and Arm CEO Rene Haas. Reuters is cited as the source, and no appointment has been made ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)).

### Deals, Partnerships, and Product Activity

- **Compute financing platforms (12 Nov 2026).** NVIDIA announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR to set up compute financing platforms intended to mobilise more than US$500bn of third-party capital. The arrangements are subject to definitive agreements ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in); [NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-partners-with-apollo-blackrock-blackstone-brookfield-goldman-sachs-and-kkr-to-establish-ai-compute-infrastructure-financing-platforms-to-mobilize-over-500-billion-of-third-party-capital)).
- **Vera Rubin ramp.** The same update said the Vera Rubin platform was ramping into full production, with racks running at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and Nebius ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)).
- **Sovereign AI (8 Nov 2026).** NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-and-supply-chain-partners-expand-capacity-to-accelerate-ai-infrastructure-buildout)). Only the headline was available to this review.
- **Supply chain.** NVIDIA announced expanded capacity with supply chain partners (headline only; date and details not verified) ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-and-supply-chain-partners-expand-capacity-to-accelerate-ai-infrastructure-buildout)).
- **Competitive pressure.** Luminal raised $23 million to challenge NVIDIA's software moat, with its inference cloud handling more than 45 trillion tokens a month ([AI Business Weekly, 2026](https://aibusinessweekly.net/p/nov-13-2026-nvidia-sudden-ceo-change)). This is a single-source startup claim.

*Background outside the window (for context only):* the Open Secure AI Alliance (27 July 2026), Spectrum-X Ethernet (22 July 2026), and a $500bn investment pool with six financial partners (11 August 2026) ([Network World, 2026](https://www.networkworld.com/article/3562856/nvidia-latest-news-and-insights.html)).

## Market and Share Price Performance

| Metric | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Record closing high | $239.24 (6 Oct 2026) | [Tickeron, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753) |
| Close, 9 Oct 2026 | $229.28 | Tickeron, 2026 |
| Close, 5 Nov 2026 | $181.60 (−9.26% on the day) | Tickeron, 2026 |
| Close, 6 Nov 2026 | $186.64 (30-day change −18.6%) | Tickeron, 2026 |
| Tuesday, 10 Nov 2026 (afternoon) | $166.95 (November −18.42%; 2026 gains erased) | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-erases-2026-gains-republicans-204550552.html) |
| Close, 13 Nov 2026 | $162.85 (−2.01%); market capitalisation $4.51T | Tickeron, 2026 |

*Calculated from these figures:* the 13 November close is about 29% below the 9 October close and about 32% below the record high.

**Attribution is conflicting.** Tickeron attributes the 5 November drop to midterm-election outcomes and concerns about data-centre regulation, describing it as a broader AI-sector repricing rather than a weakness in NVIDIA's fundamentals ([Tickeron, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753)). Yahoo Finance links the November 10 slide to congressional threats to subpoena Huang ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-erases-2026-gains-republicans-204550552.html)). Both drivers may have contributed.

**Reaction to the resignation is inconsistently reported.** Data Centre Magazine reports a fall of more than 13% in early trading on 12 November ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)), while Yahoo Finance reports more than 12% ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-ceo-huang-resigns-amid-affair-scandals-board-names-cfo-colette-kress-interim-ceo-135801377.html)).

**Low-reliability signals.** Tickeron's Aroon-based forecast of an 81% chance of lower prices is a technical pattern model, not a fundamental assessment ([Tickeron, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753)). Quantisnow's "Negative for shareholders" label is generated by its AI agent from the press release, not an analyst rating ([Quantisnow, 2026](https://quantisnow.com/insight/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition-6786728)). Its claim about post-leadership-change moves is paywalled and unverified.

## Regulatory and Political Exposure

- **Congress.** House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said he was prepared to subpoena Huang unless he responded by 11 November to a request for a closed-door briefing. No subpoena had been issued at the time of reporting ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-erases-2026-gains-republicans-204550552.html)). A CNN headline says Huang was "summoned to testify" ([CNN, 2026](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)). This conflicts with the no-subpoena report and should be verified.
- **Chip diversion probe.** The Justice Department, with the Department of Commerce, is investigating whether a Singaporean company bought advanced NVIDIA chips to send to China ([CNN, 2026](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)).
- **China revenue.** NVIDIA's prior guidance assumed no data-centre compute revenue from China ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)).

## Upcoming Event: Q3 FY2027 Results

NVIDIA will report on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, at about 1:20 p.m. PT, with the earnings call at 2 p.m. PT ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)). Prior guidance was US$108bn of revenue, plus or minus 2% ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)).

## Analyst Assessment

In my view, the transition's operational risk looks limited in the near term, while governance and regulatory risk is larger and less controllable.

1. **Continuity is credible but untested.** Kress has been CFO since 2013 and led the finance function through a period of rapid growth ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)). Still, she now holds two senior roles during the first earnings event after the change. Stakeholders will be watching for how the company handles that load.
2. **The sell-off predates the resignation.** Most of the 30-day decline occurred before 12 November, so the resignation appears to be an additional negative catalyst rather than the sole cause.
3. **Regulatory exposure may outlast the leadership question.** An unresolved chip-diversion investigation and a congressional inquiry could persist after a permanent CEO is named.
4. **Financing and growth claims depend on execution.** The US$500bn financing platforms remain subject to definitive agreements. Their terms matter for customer credit risk and revenue visibility.

## Open Questions for the Counterparty

1. **Succession and dual roles:** What criteria and timeline govern the permanent CEO search, and how will finance-control responsibilities be divided while Ms. Kress serves as both interim CEO and CFO through the Q3 results and beyond?
2. **Regulatory and China exposure:** What is the status of the Justice Department and Commerce investigation into chip shipments to a Singaporean intermediary, and of the House Foreign Affairs request for a briefing? Does the company's guidance, which excludes China data-centre compute revenue, reflect any change in export-control expectations?
3. **Financing platforms and Vera Rubin:** When are the definitive agreements for the US$500bn compute financing platforms expected to be signed, and how will the company manage customer credit and concentration risk if partners finance a growing share of Vera Rubin deployments?
